note: Real open boards from evals/typical_circuits/fixtures with datasheet facts for the hot (evidence) rules. Each check names its source document and page. 'expected' is the hand-classified result for the unmodified board; each mutation is a single value or connection change that must flip the listed checks.

+5V.citation: USB-C sink VBUS at vSafe5V (USB PD r3.1 Table 7-22: 4.75 V to 5.50 V)

checks.citation: TPS736 SBVS038X p.3 Figure 4-1 DBV SOT-23-5 and Table 4-1
TPS736 SBVS038X p.4 Recommended Operating Conditions, VIN 1.7 V to 5.5 V

voltage_analysis.method: EN tied to IN on the +5V net
voltage_analysis.loading: EN input current at most 0.1 uA (p.6), no series element
voltage_analysis.conditions: Running from a USB-C source at vSafe5V

checks.citation: TPS736 SBVS038X p.6 VEN(high) min 1.7 V; p.4 Absolute Maximum Ratings VEN -0.3 V to 6 V
AP2112 datasheet p.2 Pin Descriptions, SOT25 column
MCP73831 DS20001984H p.11 Table 3-1, SOT-23-5 column; VSS is the 0 V reference (symbol names it GND)

voltage_analysis.calculation: EN equals /VIN; regulation needs VIN at or above the 2.5 V recommended minimum
voltage_analysis.loading: No series element between VIN and EN
voltage_analysis.conditions: Running from USB 5 V through D1 or from the cell through Q1

checks.citation: AP2112 datasheet p.8 AP2112-3.3 VEN high 1.5 V to 6.0 V; p.3 recommended VIN 2.5 V to 6.0 V; p.3 Absolute Maximum Ratings list only VCC 6.5 V, no EN pin rating and no negative limit

expected_notes.U2-EN: The AP2112 datasheet gives no negative absolute rating for EN, so RST-E01 cannot close the check; this is a real data gap, not a board defect

checks.citation: TPS5430 datasheet p.3 Table 4-1 Pin Functions (the symbol names ENA as EN)
TPS5430 datasheet p.3 Table 4-1: ENA can be left floating, internal 1.5 MOhm pull-up, do not connect a resistor to ground
TMP117 datasheet p.4 Pin Functions, DRV 6-pin; the symbol names ALERT as INT and V+ as VCC
TMP117 datasheet p.4: ALERT is open-drain and requires a pull-up; p.33 recommends 5 kOhm
TMP117 datasheet p.4: SDA open-drain output requires a pull-up resistor (on the bus side of the R6 120 Ohm series resistor)

expected_notes.U1-ALERT-PULL: R2 reaches +3V3 through JP2, a SolderJumper_2_Bridged that ships closed
expected_notes.U1-SDA-PULL: R4 reaches +3V3 through JP3, a SolderJumper_3_Bridged123 that ships closed

checks.citation: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 datasheet p.11 Table Pin Definitions

voltage_analysis.method: R12 10 kOhm to +3.3V with C7 1 uF to GND
voltage_analysis.calculation: After 5 RC (50 ms) EN equals +3.3V within its 3.0 V to 3.6 V supply window
voltage_analysis.loading: EN input leakage neglected against a 10 kOhm pull-up
voltage_analysis.conditions: +3.3V within the module's recommended VDD33 3.0 V to 3.6 V; sampled after the RC delay

checks.citation: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 datasheet p.21: VDD33 3.0 V to 3.6 V; VIH_nRST 0.75 x VDD, 2.7 V at VDD 3.6 V; Table 6-1 rates VDD33 only (ESP32-C3 Table 5-1 rates input power pins only, no IO or EN pin limit)

voltage_analysis.method: Internal weak pull-up; BUT1 open; R16 100 Ohm in series with the button only
voltage_analysis.calculation: With the button open the pin sits at VDD through the internal pull-up
voltage_analysis.loading: EXT2 header assumed unloaded at reset
voltage_analysis.conditions: Normal power-up with BUT1 released, sampled within tH 3 ms after CHIP_EN

checks.citation: ESP32-C3 datasheet v2.4 p.30 Table 3-1 (GPIO9 weak pull-up) and p.31 Table 3-3 (SPI boot needs GPIO9 = 1)

voltage_analysis.loading: EXT1 and UEXT1 assumed unloaded at reset
voltage_analysis.conditions: Normal power-up, sampled within tH 3 ms after CHIP_EN

checks.citation: ESP32-C3 datasheet v2.4 p.31 Table 3-3 note 2: pull GPIO2 up to avoid glitches

expected_notes.U3-EN: Neither the module nor the chip datasheet rates the EN pin itself (only the power pins), so RST-E01 has no negative limit to check against
